issue_context.title: Services: cannot use "input_datetime.set_datetime" to set a 0 value
issue_context.body:
### The problem

This code seems to be considered as wrong:
```
service: input_datetime.set_datetime
target:
  entity_id: input_datetime.test_datetime
data:
  timestamp: 0
```
![344243116-ac9799f3-959c-4bf7-a103-25a5f7fd3108](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/71872483/3e4060ae-4727-46d3-8f0d-e82d975cc166)

This code is accepted:
```
service: input_datetime.set_datetime
target:
  entity_id: input_datetime.test_datetime
data:
  timestamp: 0.001
```
![344243760-8a63b1c1-c18c-464f-a00c-1f63ce2233a5](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/71872483/95fc708e-3f33-4e2e-8b53-32b5a3311951)

review_comments: I think we may need to freeze time to a non daylight saving date to not have a flaky test.

Maybe not. I guess the daylight info is taken from the date created in the DateTime object here, and the same for `datetime.fromtimestamp(0)`, and that is fixed to December, ie a non daylight saving date.
